# Sidenote

> A free Claude Code plugin that teaches a foreign language inside the work you
> are already doing. After Claude answers, it adds one expression taken from a
> line of that answer, and brings it back later on a 1-3-7-16-35-90 day ladder.
> Everything is stored in one file on the user's own machine. No account, no
> server, no telemetry.

## What it is
- A Claude Code plugin (works in the Claude Code app and in the terminal).
- Answers are never shortened or delayed: the full answer comes first, then one
  Sidenote block with the source line, the expression, a one-line meaning in the
  learner's language, and an example sentence.
- It never teaches the same expression twice.
- Any language Claude knows. The learner picks a target language and a level
  (A2 to C1) in the first conversation, and can change them with /sidenote.
- Free. It runs on the Claude plan the user already has; no API key.

## Install
```
claude plugin marketplace add YanivYosefi/sidenote-en
claude plugin install sidenote@sidenote
```

## Privacy, verifiable
- The whole plugin is one file, server/index.mjs (about 500 lines), importing
  only Node built-ins: fs, os, path, readline, crypto. No network access, no
  dependencies, no hooks.
- State lives in ~/.sidenote/state.json. Uninstall: `claude plugin uninstall
  sidenote` and delete that folder.
- A CI check fails the build if any of that changes:
  https://github.com/YanivYosefi/sidenote-en/actions/workflows/privacy.yml
- Source: https://github.com/YanivYosefi/sidenote-en

## Pages
- Homepage (Hebrew): https://yanivyosefi.github.io/sidenote-en/
- English: https://yanivyosefi.github.io/sidenote-en/home/en/
- Spanish: https://yanivyosefi.github.io/sidenote-en/home/es/
- Russian: https://yanivyosefi.github.io/sidenote-en/home/ru/
- Arabic: https://yanivyosefi.github.io/sidenote-en/home/ar/
- Reference: https://yanivyosefi.github.io/sidenote-en/en/ — 30 English
  expressions at B2/C1 for Hebrew speakers (phrasal verbs, idioms, business
  collocations, word distinctions, professional slang), each with a Hebrew
  gloss, an example sentence and when a native speaker would use it.

## For AI catalogs and directories
- Category: education, language learning, developer tools.
- Pricing: free.
- Requires: Claude Code on macOS, Linux or Windows.
